localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description:
This group camp has a minimum occupancy of 20 people and a maximum of 50 people. Groups with over 50 people may have part or all of their group cited and evicted. There is a 140 ft pull through parking lane for onsite parking and a small vehicle lot for offsite parking. No RVs are allowed in the offsite parking lot. Groups are allowed a maximum of 20 vehicles total. No more than 4 of the total vehicles may include RVs. All RVs must fit in the onsite parking lane, and no utility hookups are available.
This group camp is located at the park entrance. There is a grass area ideal for tents and a central fire ring for use when campfires are permitted. The restroom is about a 4-minute walk down the hill from the camp area. This area offers minimal shade and minimal onsite parking. Up to 4 RVs may be allowed, though they are not recommended. Call the park for more details.
